# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes static transverse loading, a slender beam idealization, concentrated vertical pulley resultants, vertical bearing reactions only in the selected plane, negligible shaft self-weight, and small deformation. It excludes torsion, axial loading, dynamic belt effects, bearing friction, and local hub or contact stresses. Because no shaft diameter, section modulus, material strength, or fatigue data are provided, do not add a numerical bending-stress or factor-of-safety calculation.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and load path: 20%;
- student idealization and assumptions: 20%;
- equilibrium and bearing reactions: 20%;
- shear and bending-moment analysis: 30%;
- critical-location assessment and limited recommendation: 10%.
